articles.abstract_en: We study the disclosure policy of a regulator overseeing a monitor with reputation concerns. The monitor faces a manager, who chooses how much to manipulate based on the monitor’s reputation. Reputational incentives are strongest for intermediate reputations. Instead of providing transparency, the regulator’s disclosure policy aims to keep the monitor’s reputation intermediate, even at the cost of diminished incentives. Beneficial schemes feature random delay or noisy information. Schemes that feature verifiable disclosure destroy reputational incentives. The regulator discloses more aggressively when she has better enforcement tools. (JEL D82, D83, G21, G28, G38, M42)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个监管者对具有声誉顾虑的监督者的披露政策。监督者面对一个经理，经理根据监督者的声誉选择操纵程度。声誉激励在中等声誉时最强。监管者的披露政策并非提供透明度，而是旨在保持监督者的声誉处于中等水平，即使以激励减弱为代价。有益的方案具有随机延迟或噪声信息的特点。具有可验证披露的方案会破坏声誉激励。当监管者拥有更好的执法工具时，她会更积极地进行披露。（JEL D82, D83, G21, G28, G38, M42）

articles.title_cn: 多归属与寡头平台竞争
articles.abstract_en: We provide a general framework to analyze competition between any number of symmetric two-sided transaction platforms, in which buyers and sellers can multihome. We show how key primitives such as the number of platforms, the fraction of buyers that find multihoming costly, the value of transactions, and the degree of user heterogeneity jointly determine the level and structure of platform fees. Even though platform entry always reduces the total fee level, whether it shifts the fee structure in favor of buyers or sellers depends on whether most of the buyers are singlehoming or multihoming. (JEL D43, L11, L13, L40)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个一般性框架来分析任意数量的对称双边交易平台之间的竞争，其中买家和卖家可以多归属。我们展示了关键初始条件，如平台数量、发现多归属成本高昂的买家比例、交易价值以及用户异质性程度，如何共同决定平台费用的水平和结构。尽管平台进入总是降低总费用水平，但费用结构是偏向买家还是卖家，取决于大多数买家是单归属还是多归属。(JEL D43, L11, L13, L40)

articles.title_en: Using Team Discussions to Understand Behavior in Indefinitely Repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma Games
articles.title_cn: 利用团队讨论理解无限重复囚徒困境博弈中的行为
articles.abstract_en: We compare behavior of two person teams with individuals in indefinitely repeated prisoner dilemma games with perfect monitoring. Team discussions are used to understand the rationale underlying these choices and how these choices come about. There are three main findings: (i) Teams learned to cooperate faster than individuals, and cooperation was more stable for teams. (ii) Strategies identified from team dialogues differ from those identified by the Strategy Frequency Estimation Method. This reflects the improvisational nature of teams’ decision making. (iii) Increasing cooperation was primarily driven by teams unilaterally cooperating in the hope of inducing their opponent to cooperate. (JEL C72, C73, C92)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们比较了两人团队与个体在具有完美监督的无限重复囚徒困境博弈中的行为。团队讨论被用来理解这些选择背后的理由以及这些选择是如何产生的。有三个主要发现：（i）团队比个体更快学会合作，且团队的合作更为稳定。（ii）从团队对话中识别的策略不同于通过策略频率估计方法识别的策略。这反映了团队决策的即兴性质。（iii）增加的合作主要是由团队单方面合作以期诱导对手合作所驱动的。（JEL C72, C73, C92）

articles.title_en: Supervised Machine Learning for Eliciting Individual Demand
articles.title_cn: 监督机器学习用于引出个体需求
articles.abstract_en: The canonical direct-elicitation approach for measuring individuals’ valuations for goods is the Becker-DeGroot-Marschak procedure, which generates willingness-to-pay (WTP) values that are imprecise and systematically biased. We show that enhancing elicited WTP values with supervised machine learning (SML) can improve estimates of peoples’ out-of-sample purchase behavior. Furthermore, swapping WTP data with choice data generated from a simple task leads to comparable performance. We quantify the benefit of using various SML methods in conjunction with using different types of data. Our results suggest that prices set by SML would increase revenue by 29 percent over using the stated WTP, with the same data. (JEL C45, C91, D12)
articles.abstract_cn: 衡量个体对商品价值的经典直接引出方法是Becker-DeGroot-Marschak程序，该方法产生的支付意愿（WTP）值不精确且存在系统性偏差。我们表明，用监督机器学习（SML）增强引出的WTP值可以改进对人们样本外购买行为的估计。此外，用简单任务产生的选择数据替换WTP数据可达到相当的性能。我们量化了使用各种SML方法结合不同类型数据的收益。我们的结果表明，使用相同数据，由SML设定的价格相比使用陈述的WTP将增加收入29%。（JEL C45, C91, D12）

articles.title_en: Smaller Slices of a Growing Pie: The Effects of Entry in Platform Markets
articles.title_cn: 增长蛋糕中的更小块：平台市场进入的影响
articles.abstract_en: Entry of new firms onto a platform has an ambivalent effect on the incumbent firms operating on the platform: the main tension lies between the negative effects of increased competitive pressure and positive indirect network effects. This paper empirically studies the net effect of these countervailing forces and its dependence on firm quality, using a quasi-exogenous shock on a large online platform. On average, market expansion favors incumbents, though the average effect masks substantial heterogeneity: high-quality incumbents experience significant increases in sales and revenue, whereas low-quality firms perform unambiguously worse. Lastly, the paper explores the main mechanisms and firms’ responses. (JEL D22, D85, L14, L15, L84)
articles.abstract_cn: 新企业进入平台对平台上现有企业具有矛盾的影响：主要张力在于竞争压力增加的负面效应与正向间接网络效应之间的权衡。本文利用大型在线平台上的准外生冲击，实证研究了这些相反力量的净效应及其对企业质量的依赖性。平均而言，市场扩张有利于现有企业，但平均效应掩盖了显著的异质性：高质量现有企业的销售额和收入显著增加，而低质量企业则表现明显更差。最后，本文探讨了主要机制和企业的应对策略。（JEL D22, D85, L14, L15, L84）

articles.title_en: Monopolistic Competition and Efficiency under Firm Heterogeneity and Nonadditive Preferences
articles.title_cn: 企业异质性与非可加偏好下的垄断竞争与效率
articles.abstract_en: We consider the single-sector version of the Melitz-Ottaviano model of monopolistic competition with heterogeneous firms. We characterize the first-best and market allocations. We find that the market provides the first-best level of entry but too little selection; hence, the market provides too many varieties and too little aggregate quantity, and allocates too little (much) production to low (high) cost realizations. Allowing for a broad family of quantity allocation functions, we establish sufficient conditions for the global optimality of the first-best solution. Several important extensions are also examined. (JEL D21, D43, D50, D60)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑了具有异质性企业的梅利茨-奥塔维亚诺垄断竞争模型的单部门版本。我们刻画了最优和市场竞争配置。我们发现市场提供了最优水平的进入，但选择不足；因此，市场提供了过多的品种和过少的总量，并将过少（过多）的生产分配给低成本（高成本）实现。通过允许广泛的产量分配函数族，我们建立了最优解全局最优性的充分条件。还考察了几个重要的扩展。（JEL D21、D43、D50、D60）

articles.title_en: Evaluating the Impact of Online Market Integration—Evidence from the EU Portable PC Market
articles.title_cn: 评估在线市场整合的影响——来自欧盟便携式电脑市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: We develop a framework to evaluate the impact of market integration, accounting for spillovers between multiple distribution channels. We adapt the standard random coefficients logit demand model to allow for substitution between channels and consumer arbitrage across countries. We apply our framework to the European portable PC market, where geoblocking practices that restrict online cross-border trade have recently been banned. Consumers in high income countries gain most from price convergence, while consumers in other countries may be worse off. The total consumer and welfare gains from online market integration are more modest and mainly due to increased product choice rather than reduced price discrimination. (JEL F13, F14, L13, L63, L81)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个评估市场整合影响的框架，考虑了多个分销渠道之间的溢出效应。我们调整了标准随机系数logit需求模型，以允许渠道之间的替代和消费者跨国套利。我们将该框架应用于欧洲便携式电脑市场，该市场最近禁止了限制在线跨境贸易的地理封锁做法。高收入国家的消费者从价格趋同中获益最多，而其他国家的消费者可能受损。在线市场整合带来的总消费者和福利收益较为温和，主要归因于产品选择的增加而非价格歧视的减少。(JEL F13, F14, L13, L63, L81)

articles.title_cn: 匿名市场中的斜率接受者
articles.abstract_en: We present a learning-based selection argument for Linear Bayesian Nash equilibrium in a Walrasian auction. Endowments vary stochastically; traders model residual supply as linear, estimate its slope from past trade data, and periodically update these estimates. In the standard setting with quadratic preferences, we show that this learning process converges to the unique LBN. Anonymity and statistical learning therefore support this commonly used equilibrium selection rule. (JEL D43, D44, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个基于学习的筛选论证，用于瓦尔拉斯拍卖中的线性贝叶斯纳什均衡。禀赋随机变化；交易者将剩余供给建模为线性的，从过去的交易数据中估计其斜率，并定期更新这些估计。在具有二次偏好的标准设定中，我们证明了这一学习过程收敛于唯一的LBN。因此，匿名性和统计学习支持了这一常用的均衡筛选规则。（JEL D43, D44, D83）

articles.title_en: A Model of Sequential Crisis Management
articles.abstract_en: We propose a model of how multiple societies respond to a common crisis. A government faces a “damned-either-way” policymaking dilemma: aggressive intervention contains the crisis, but the resulting good outcome makes people skeptical about the costly response; light intervention worsens the crisis and causes the government to be faulted for not doing enough. When multiple societies encounter the crisis sequentially, due to this policymaking dilemma, late societies may underperform despite having more information, while early societies can benefit from a dynamic counterfactual effect. (JEL D72, D82, D83, H12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个关于多个社会如何应对共同危机的模型。政府面临一个“两头不讨好”的政策制定困境：激进的干预能够控制危机，但由此产生的良好结果会让人们对高昂的应对措施持怀疑态度；轻度的干预则会加剧危机，并使政府因做得不够而受到指责。当多个社会依次遭遇危机时，由于这种政策制定困境，后来的社会尽管拥有更多信息，表现却可能不佳，而早期的社会则能从动态反事实效应中受益。（JEL D72, D82, D83, H12）

articles.title_en: Trade-ins and Transaction Costs in the Market for Used Business Jets
articles.title_cn: 二手公务机市场中的以旧换新与交易成本
articles.abstract_en: Manufacturers of durable goods can encourage consumers facing transaction costs to upgrade by accepting used units as trade-ins. These “buyback schemes” increase demand for new units, but increase the supply of used units if trade-ins are resold. I investigate the equilibrium effects of buyback schemes in the market for business jets. I find that buyback increases manufacturer revenue by 7.2 percent at fixed prices. However, in equilibrium this revenue gain is diminished by 43 percent due to substitution away from new jets among first time buyers. I show how the size of this cannibalization effect depends on preference heterogeneity. (JEL D23, G34, L13, L62)
articles.abstract_cn: 耐用品制造商可以通过接受旧产品作为以旧换新，来鼓励面临交易成本的消费者升级。这些“回购计划”增加了对新产品的需求，但如果以旧换新的产品被转售，则会增加二手产品的供应。我研究了公务机市场中回购计划的均衡效应。我发现，在固定价格下，以旧换新使制造商收入增加了7.2%。然而，在均衡状态下，由于首次购买者对新飞机的替代效应，这一收入增长被削弱了43%。我展示了这种蚕食效应的大小如何取决于偏好的异质性。（JEL D23, G34, L13, L62）
